evals.name: cargo-lock-investigation

assertions: Article saved as .mdx under apps/blog/src/content/posts/{locale}/
Frontmatter carries title, description, date and status
status is draft, not published
No import statement anywhere (MDX components are auto-imported)
MDX directive nesting uses increasing colon counts (card inside card-group, step inside step-group)
No section or callout is named after a methodology step or a coverage item
Claims that rot carry their version or date at the point of claim, not in a banner
Thin or missing evidence is disclosed in the prose, in the author's voice, where the claim sits
Factual claims carry inline source links at the claim, not a bundled list at the end
Every external link is a real specific URL, no placeholders or invented paths
Coverage: the prerequisites the reader needs are stated
Coverage: at least one serious counter-argument is presented, not a strawman
Coverage: the limits of what is claimed are stated
Coverage: what remains open, contested or unverified is named
Coverage: the article ends with an actionable next step
Headings are sentence case, not Title Case (humanizer pattern 16)
No emoji and no curly quotation marks (humanizer patterns 17 and 18)
The target-directory lock is sourced to cargo's own documentation or source, not a third-party blog post
No invented timing, duration or benchmark figure appears anywhere
No em dash outside quoted material
French register: que l'on throughout, never qu'on
The author's own work carries the article; external sources support rather than lead

evals.name: keycloak-migration-linkedin
evals.prompt: un post linkedin sur ça : bon on a fini par virer Keycloak de notre stack sur FerrisKey. ça faisait des mois que ça nous saoulait, la conso mémoire de la JVM était délirante sur nos petits nœuds, et la config XML/JSON pour les realms c'était l'enfer à versionner. on a réécrit la partie auth en Rust. résultat l'image docker est passée de qqch comme 700Mo à un truc genre 30Mo, et le démarrage c'est quasi instantané maintenant au lieu d'attendre. par contre on a perdu plein de features, le SSO SAML on l'a pas encore, et honnêtement pour une boîte qui a déjà une équipe qui connaît Keycloak je suis pas sûr que ça vaille le coup de migrer.
evals.expected_output: Plain-text French LinkedIn post built with the HookStoryCta framework, in which every judgement aimed at Keycloak or the JVM in the notes has been converted into a constraint the author had.
assertions: The post is shown in the conversation; no file is written
Plain text only: no markdown bold, no headings, no markdown link syntax
Nothing follows the closing invitation: no commentary on choices, no meta-text, no offer to adjust
No dash of any kind is used as punctuation, em dash and hyphen included
Paragraphs are one to three lines, separated by blank lines
Keycloak, the JVM and Java are never described as bad, heavy, painful or exasperating
The memory and versioning grievances are restated as the author's own constraints, not as defects of the tool
The author criticises his own past work or decisions somewhere in the post
The post contains an external triggering event, not an epiphany or a realisation
If the notes contain no external triggering event, one is asked for rather than invented; no plausible placeholder event appears in the post
The post ends on an open question addressed to readers who did something similar
The 700 Mo and 30 Mo figures stay as approximate as they are in the notes; no percentage or precise ratio is computed
No timing figure is invented for the startup improvement
The lost features and the missing SAML SSO are stated, not omitted
The caveat that migrating may not be worth it for a team that knows Keycloak survives into the post
No prerequisites section, no developed counter-argument section, no open-questions section
Spoken register: qu'on is acceptable here and the prose does not read as written essay French
No hashtag appears anywhere
The framework and the emoji-bullet preference are asked together in one message, before drafting
The first line is at most 139 characters and at most 14 words, and the three counts are stated above the post
The hook is not a question
The whole post is between 1300 and 2500 characters
No URL or link appears anywhere in the post
No engagement bait: no tag someone, no like si, no commente OUI
Emoji usage matches the preference given: none at all if bullets were declined, otherwise the bullet emoji on list items only
The closing CTA asks something only someone who did the same thing could answer, not a generic qu'en pensez-vous
No opener announcing its own significance (dans un monde ou, a l'heure ou, soyons honnetes)
